paper.title: Spontaneous group formation in the Seceder model

headline: Seceder model (Dittrich et al. 2000, agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; steady clusters ~5.6 (>= 2), variance ~353 = 8820x the mutation floor; honest caveat: measured cluster count (~5-6) exceeds the canonical ~3 because group centres diffuse apart at the locked small sigma_mut

verdicts.gate: P1 spontaneous multi-cluster formation: steady cluster count >= 2 (every seed)
P2 diversity persists: min steady variance >= 10x the mutation floor (no collapse to a point)
P3 cluster structure stable: persistent multi-cluster + approximately-constant count over the late run (not a transient)

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce spontaneous multi-group formation from a single 'reproduce the outlier' rule and would catch an artifact

citations: Dittrich, P., Liljeros, F., Soulier, A. & Banzhaf, W. (2000). Spontaneous group formation in the Seceder model. Phys. Rev. Lett. 84(14):3205-3208. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.84.3205.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the locked cluster-count rule (gap-cut + minimum occupancy) + population variance
